addModel.addedInstallLater: Added {{name}}. Install when you are ready.
addModel.gatedAgree: gated (agree on the model page with your HF_TOKEN account)
addModel.name: Name
addModel.noWeightFiles: No weight files listed. Paste a URL that includes the filename.

addImageModel.hint: Paste a Hugging Face URL or org/repo. A diffusers repo installs whole; a single .safetensors is a checkpoint (SD, SDXL) or a LoRA. FLUX and Qwen-Image 2.1 stills are one UNET in ComfyUI.
addImageModel.noLoraFamily: No family in this list stacks that LoRA.
addImageModel.noWiredFamily: No wired family fits this repo. Paste a checkpoint, a FLUX or Qwen-Image 2.1 UNET, or a diffusers repo this product already runs.
addImageModel.wholeRepo: The whole repo installs, the same way the shipped models do.

addVideoModel.hint: Paste a Hugging Face URL or org/repo. The file lands in ComfyUI the same way Install already works. Pick whether it is a LoRA on a model you have, another UNET like one, or a text encoder that stands in for the one a model ships with.
addVideoModel.noShippedModel: No shipped model in this list takes that role.
addVideoModel.moeHint: This family is two experts. Pick one HighNoise file and one LowNoise file.
addVideoModel.encoderHint: One file. It replaces the shipped text encoder for every model in that family; pick it on the Video Gen page under Text encoder. The shipped one stays installed.

audioFoundryModels.pluginStartFailed: Could not start Audio Foundry. Check Plugins and audio_foundry.log.
audioFoundryModels.acceptTerms: Accept terms at <anchor>{{repo}}</anchor>, then set HF_TOKEN in .env.
audioFoundryModels.title: Audio Studio models
audioFoundryModels.intro: Voice, music and FX weights install into the shared Hugging Face cache (ACE-Step 1.5 into data/models, with its own Python environment). Generation will not download them on its own.

imageModels.title: Manage Image Generation Models
imageModels.fluxNote: <bold>FLUX.1-dev</bold> stills install here. Add another FLUX UNET or LoRA with Add new model. Keyframe GGUF packs (schnell) still live under <bold>Video Models</bold>.
imageModels.checkAccessTooltip: Asks huggingface.co whether each model that is not installed can be downloaded. Sends no token; Install uses yours.
imageModels.removeDescription: Drops it from your catalog. Downloaded files stay unless you turn on Delete downloaded files.

infographicModels.title: Infographic Models (Flux schnell)
infographicModels.intro: Four files power the Infographic tab — diffusion model, two text encoders, and a VAE. They install into ComfyUI's model tree, so the comfyui plugin must be enabled to use them.

upscalingModels.title: Manage Upscaling Models
upscalingModels.ready: Ready to use in the upscaler
upscalingModels.notInstalled: Not installed — Install adds it to the model dropdown
upscalingModels.noModels: No upscaling models returned from the service.

videoModels.title: Manage Video Models
videoModels.noneInstalled: No video model is installed yet. Install one below to enable video generation — each model's download size and VRAM requirement is shown so you can pick what fits your machine.
videoModels.removeDescription: Drops it from your catalog. Downloaded files under ComfyUI/models go away unless you turn that off.
